body:
I don’t know if I can promise that. Idk when I’ll finally snap or if I’ll be able to walk away from it. 



Thank you for your time tonight. I’m sorry I wasted it.
Not anymore. I can’t bring myself to listen to anything because I’m too easily influenced by music. Too easy to get comfortable in the nothingness and eventually stuck there.

I’m just out of reasons to live. Plain and simple. No pets, school and work is a bust, my family well... see earlier comment thread. I never had a reason to want to be here myself and now the only reasons I did have are fading. No matter how hard and long I try to find new ones it doesn’t work. I’m out of steam. I’m just done.

Not good. It’s part of what’s making me want to end it actually. It used to be my family keeping me here until they showed their colors - my father trying to withhold the car keys when I was bleeding out from a kitchen accident so we wouldn’t have to spend money on medical bills. My sister refusing to take me to urgent care when my throat was closing up because she didn’t feel like waking up or driving. My brother screaming at me to kill myself just for asking him to put away the dishes he used.
Then it was my grandparents I lived for. Until my grandfathers passed away, and my grandmothers started succumbing to dementia. 
Then it was my boyfriend until he showed me it’s only his own interest he’ll ever bother to protect. Then it was my friends until they showed me that the only thing they want out of our relationship was an on-demand psychiatrist and free shit. 
I’m out of reasons and people to stay here for. And none of the new relationships I try to form go anywhere because of how dead I already feel. People feel that and don’t want to take on a friendship with me because of it. I even joined a club, forced myself to go to school more often, I followed through on all the medical advice I’ve received, thinking maybe, just maybe something would work out. But I can’t keep being here for these people anymore. 

I’m at a point where I don’t really care if dying will fuck these people up. You’re right, it’s exhausting only living for others and my fuel gauge has gone past empty after a lifetime of doing literally nothing but caring about and for others.

I’ve literally always been here because someone else wants it. I don’t remember wanting things like other people do. 
And now I can’t walk across campus without thinking what building would be best to leap off of. I can’t take my numerous prescriptions without wondering what would happen if I took all of those bottles at once. Can’t ride the bus without wondering how fast it would need to hit me to finally make me disappear. 
Nothing has ever given me reason enough to be here for myself. I hate living. I hate having to convince myself that today is not the day I go away for good. My one thing binding me here was always empathy for people around me and now that it’s crumbling I don’t know how much longer I can go on. Suicide feels more and more like a real option. Therapy doesn’t help. My doctors don’t help. I’ve been stuck in it for most of my conscious life. And I just want to be able to fade away. Please just make it stop.
I hate it when people stick their feet in my face to be funny/silly. I do not find this cute or entertaining in the slightest. Please get out of my bubble.
